findings.finding: Caveat says the results file 'does not record whether the run used the pinned Docker mode'. But the pinned Docker mode did not exist when this run was made: fleet_runner.py at ed63ef4 (the commit that added the 2026-09-10 results) has no --docker option, and --docker was added in 2b4be54 on 2026-09-11 (#31). So the run used whatever hummbl-governance was installed locally, not the 1.1.0 pin, and library-baseline scores (0.769) may include API-drift failures. Wording it as unknown understates a known limitation.
findings.recommendation: State plainly that the run used the local (non-Docker) mode with an unpinned, unrecorded hummbl-governance version, so library-lane scores may reflect API drift vs the 1.1.0 pin
